_about: Images the site uses that were derived from Yahia's own photos by processing, not supplied directly. The source photo is always listed; nothing here replaces a source. PHOTO_MANIFEST.json remains the record of every supplied photo.

tools.depth: Depth Anything V2 Small (onnx-community/depth-anything-v2-small, ONNX, CPU)

assets.process: Yahia and the chair cut out of the studio background (isnet-general-use), trimmed to the subject with 40px margin, 1400px tall, WebP with alpha.
assets.used_by: Home hero: the fallback , and the colour texture of the WebGL relief mesh and point cloud.

assets.process: Monocular depth, re-normalised inside the silhouette only (2nd-98th percentile) so the figure uses the full range, then bled outward past the edge so edge vertices never snap to zero, Gaussian sigma 3, half resolution.
assets.used_by: Home hero: displacement for the relief mesh and the point cloud.

assets.source: Each project's LAYOUTS hero per version (getHeroImage), plus the INOS Watcher V3 and INOS Gauge V3 cut-out renders used on the home showroom ring.
assets.process: Monocular depth at 518px, normalised inside the alpha for cut-outs (globally for context photos), edge-bled for cut-outs, Gaussian sigma 2, half resolution.
assets.index: assets/img/depth/depth-maps.js maps each source photo path to its depth map.
assets.used_by: Work page tiles and the home showroom: 3D relief (cut-outs) or in-frame parallax (context photos).

assets.process: Filmic contrast, split-tone (shadows toward the site's near-black, highlights toward the tan accent), vignette centred on the grinder. Also sparks-sm.webp at half size.
assets.used_by: Home workshop section, full-bleed. The grinder's contact point (53% across, 80% down) is the emitter for the live GPU sparks.
